title: Discard is now a safe mistake
why: Discard on a proposal shows 'proposal set aside (13 shots) — Ctrl+Z brings it back' with an Undo button; Ctrl+Z brought the whole proposal back. Discard is placed apart from Accept.

title: Typed timecode errors say what went wrong and what to type
why: '"banana" is not a timecode — try 40. or 1:05 or 00:00:40:00 or +2.' and 'past the end of the film (00:01:07:17), went to its last frame' — exactly what a clumsy person needs.

title: Undo and redo survive reloads, step for step
why: Undid 20 and redid 20 with two F5 reloads in the middle; at every step the film (count, length, order) matched what it had been, and the arrows name each step ('undo: paste a shot', 'redo: AI: ripple delete').

title: Background export with 'Keep working', and Cancel that says 'Nothing was written'
why: Export ran in the background while I kept editing; it rendered the film as it was when I pressed Export (60.39 s), and cancelling from the dialog says 'Export cancelled. Nothing was written.' (and nothing was).

title: The title check catches a bad title
why: After my doubled words, the card at once said '✗ a bar cuts across the words · Fit to frame' — it really looked at the frame. Copy/paste inside the words box stayed in the box (no shots were cut or pasted).

title: Music path mistakes are explained
why: '001-start.png is not a music file the board takes (.png); use mp3, wav, m4a or flac', 'no file at that path on this computer', 'that path is a folder; give the path of one music file' — each says what to do.

title: Copy/paste with nothing selected explains itself
why: 'nothing selected — click a shot, then Ctrl+C' and 'nothing to paste — select shots and press Ctrl+C (or Ctrl+X) first'.

title: New film dialog: a real folder browser with plain errors
why: Places links, video counts per folder, 'that is a file, not a folder', 'no such folder', and Make the film stays off on a folder with no video.

title: A reload mid-export brings the export back with an honest note
why: After F5 at 45 % the export dialog came back still running, saying 'This is an export of the cut as it was at 11:49 AM. Edits you make while it renders are not in this file.'
